Callout.Name: Phone Snatch
Callout.Message: Phone taken from a caller's hand in the street.
Callout.Advisory: Suspect on foot, victim chasing, no weapon seen.

Script.Line: It was on the table outside the cafe. I picked it up.
I was going to hand it in. I was walking towards the station.
It is in my pocket. Here. Here it is.

Lines.Approach: He took the phone out of her hand and ran. She is chasing him, which is not what I would advise.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
